SELECT d.name AS department, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 'active' GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY employee_count DESC, department
SELECT CAST(SUM(salary) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS total_salary FROM analytics.employees WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT CAST(AVG(salary) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS average_salary FROM analytics.employees WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT i.invoice_number, CAST(SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS invoice_total FROM analytics.invoices i JOIN analytics.invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY invoice_total DESC
SELECT category, CAST(SUM(amount) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS total_cost FROM analytics.project_costs GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_cost DESC
SELECT CAST(SUM(base_salary + bonus - deductions) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS net_payroll FROM analytics.payroll WHERE period_start = DATE '2025-02-01'
SELECT e.full_name, d.name AS department, e.salary FROM analytics.employees e JOIN analytics.departments d ON d.id = e.department_id WHERE e.status = 'active' ORDER BY e.salary DESC, e.full_name

SELECT p.project_code, c.name AS customer, d.name AS department FROM analytics.projects p JOIN analytics.customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id JOIN analytics.departments d ON d.id = p.owning_department_id ORDER BY p.project_code

SELECT i.invoice_number, c.name AS customer, CAST(SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS invoice_total FROM analytics.invoices i JOIN analytics.customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id JOIN analytics.invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY i.invoice_number, c.name ORDER BY i.invoice_number

SELECT p.project_code, e.full_name, a.allocation_percent FROM analytics.employee_project_assignments a JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.id = a.employee_id JOIN analytics.projects p ON p.id = a.project_id ORDER BY p.project_code, e.full_name

SELECT p.project_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.employee_id) AS assigned_employees FROM analytics.projects p LEFT JOIN analytics.employee_project_assignments a ON a.project_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'active' GROUP BY p.project_code ORDER BY p.project_code

SELECT c.name AS customer, CAST(SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS invoiced_revenue FROM analytics.customers c JOIN analytics.invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.id JOIN analytics.invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY invoiced_revenue DESC

WITH revenue AS (SELECT i.project_id, SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS revenue FROM analytics.invoices i JOIN analytics.invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY i.project_id), costs AS (SELECT project_id, SUM(amount) AS costs FROM analytics.project_costs GROUP BY project_id) SELECT p.project_code, CAST(r.revenue AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS revenue, CAST(COALESCE(c.costs, 0) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS costs, CAST(r.revenue - COALESCE(c.costs, 0) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS margin FROM analytics.projects p JOIN revenue r ON r.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN costs c ON c.project_id = p.id ORDER BY p.project_code

SELECT d.name AS department, CAST(SUM(p.budget) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS total_budget FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.projects p ON p.owning_department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY total_budget DESC

WITH department_salary AS (SELECT d.name AS department, AVG(e.salary) AS average_salary FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 'active' GROUP BY d.name), company_salary AS (SELECT AVG(salary) AS average_salary FROM analytics.employees WHERE status = 'active') SELECT ds.department, CAST(ds.average_salary AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS average_salary FROM department_salary ds CROSS JOIN company_salary cs WHERE ds.average_salary > cs.average_salary ORDER BY ds.department

SELECT e.full_name, e.salary FROM analytics.employees e WHERE e.status = 'active' AND e.salary > (SELECT AVG(peer.salary) FROM analytics.employees peer WHERE peer.department_id = e.department_id AND peer.status = 'active') ORDER BY e.salary DESC, e.full_name

WITH customer_revenue AS (SELECT c.name AS customer, SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS revenue FROM analytics.customers c JOIN analytics.invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.id JOIN analytics.invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY c.name) SELECT customer, CAST(revenue AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS revenue FROM customer_revenue WHERE revenue > 100000 ORDER BY revenue DESC

WITH project_totals AS (SELECT p.id, p.project_code, COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) AS total_cost FROM analytics.projects p LEFT JOIN analytics.project_costs pc ON pc.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.project_code), average_cost AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_cost FROM project_totals) SELECT pt.project_code, CAST(pt.total_cost AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS total_cost FROM project_totals pt CROSS JOIN average_cost ac WHERE pt.total_cost > ac.average_cost ORDER BY pt.total_cost DESC

SELECT d.name AS department, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 'active' GROUP BY d.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY employee_count DESC, department

WITH ranked AS (SELECT d.name AS department, e.full_name, e.salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.id ORDER BY e.salary DESC, e.full_name) AS salary_rank FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 'active') SELECT department, full_name, salary FROM ranked WHERE salary_rank = 1 ORDER BY department

WITH ranked AS (SELECT d.name AS department, e.full_name, e.salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.id ORDER BY e.salary DESC, e.full_name) AS salary_rank FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 'active') SELECT department, full_name, salary, salary_rank FROM ranked WHERE salary_rank <= 2 ORDER BY department, salary_rank

WITH invoice_totals AS (SELECT i.id, i.invoice_number, i.issued_on, SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS invoice_total FROM analytics.invoices i JOIN analytics.invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY i.id, i.invoice_number, i.issued_on) SELECT invoice_number, issued_on, CAST(invoice_total AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS invoice_total, CAST(SUM(invoice_total) OVER (ORDER BY issued_on, id) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS cumulative_revenue FROM invoice_totals ORDER BY issued_on, id

WITH category_cost AS (SELECT p.project_code, pc.category, SUM(pc.amount) AS total_cost FROM analytics.projects p JOIN analytics.project_costs pc ON pc.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.project_code, pc.category) SELECT project_code, category, CAST(total_cost AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS total_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS cost_rank FROM category_cost ORDER BY project_code, cost_rank

WITH monthly AS (SELECT period_start, SUM(base_salary) AS base_payroll FROM analytics.payroll GROUP BY period_start) SELECT period_start, CAST(base_payroll AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS base_payroll, CAST(base_payroll - LAG(base_payroll) OVER (ORDER BY period_start) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS change_from_previous FROM monthly ORDER BY period_start
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hires FROM analytics.employees WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND hire_date < DATE '2023-01-01'
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date)::INTEGER AS hire_year, COUNT(*) AS hires FROM analytics.employees WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY hire_year ORDER BY hire_year
SELECT invoice_number, due_on, status FROM analytics.invoices WHERE due_on >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND due_on < DATE '2025-04-01' ORDER BY due_on

SELECT p.project_code, CAST(SUM(pc.amount) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS total_cost FROM analytics.projects p JOIN analytics.project_costs pc ON pc.project_id = p.id WHERE pc.cost_date >= DATE '2025-02-01' AND pc.cost_date < DATE '2025-03-01' GROUP BY p.project_code ORDER BY p.project_code

SELECT period_start, CAST(SUM(base_salary + bonus - deductions) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS net_payroll FROM analytics.payroll WHERE period_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-02-01' GROUP BY period_start ORDER BY period_start
SELECT project_code, name FROM analytics.projects WHERE start_date <= DATE '2025-02-01' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= DATE '2025-02-01') ORDER BY project_code

SELECT d.name AS department, CAST(SUM(e.salary) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS total_payroll FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 'active' GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY total_payroll DESC LIMIT 1

WITH totals AS (SELECT c.name AS customer, SUM(il.quantity * il.unit_price) AS amount FROM analytics.customers c JOIN analytics.invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.id JOIN analytics.invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY c.name) SELECT CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN customer = 'Gulf Logistics' THEN amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN customer = 'Nile Retail Group' THEN amount END) AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS difference FROM totals

SELECT p.project_code, CAST(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) / p.budget AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) AS budget_used_percent FROM analytics.projects p LEFT JOIN analytics.project_costs pc ON pc.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.project_code, p.budget ORDER BY p.project_code

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.name = 'Engineering' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS headcount_difference FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 'active' AND d.name IN ('Engineering', 'Finance')
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'inactive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive_customers FROM analytics.customers

WITH ranked AS (SELECT d.name AS department, SUM(e.salary) AS total_payroll, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(e.salary) DESC) AS payroll_rank FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE e.status = 'active' GROUP BY d.name) SELECT department, CAST(total_payroll AS DECIMAL(14, 2)) AS total_payroll FROM ranked WHERE payroll_rank = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_employees FROM analytics.departments d JOIN analytics.employees e ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE d.name = 'Engineering' AND e.status = 'active'
SELECT project_code, budget FROM analytics.projects WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 1
